paragraphs: High in the Andes, a simple sling could turn a stone into a deadly weapon. Inca armies carried this ancient weapon across a vast mountain empire ruled from Cusco.
The Inca Slinger brings that tradition to the battlefield, sending volleys of stones into enemy ranks.
Slingers deal bonus damage to infantry, monks and siege units. They require no gold to train, making them a useful option when precious resources run low.
Inca technologies strengthen their attacks and improve their protection. Yet these light soldiers still need room to fight: a mounted charge can turn a safe distance into a dangerous melee.
